sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Copies the static home page into place
sections.what: Copies the hand-built home page over the default index file created by the build, and prints a confirmation line.
sections.why: The header states that the rest of the site stays in Next, and only the home page is replaced.
sections.watch_out: If the build has not run first, the copy fails because the out folder does not exist.

summary: Copies the hand-built home page over the default page that the Next.js build produces.
purpose: Makes the site's home page the hand-built version instead of the generic one.
why: The header says the home page is hand-built and must replace Next's placeholder index.
how: Runs after the build, copies home/index.html to out/index.html, and prints one line.
inputs: home/index.html and the out folder created by the build.
outputs: out/index.html is overwritten. One line is printed.
risks: Fails with an error if either file is missing. It overwrites the output without asking.
debug: If the home page shows the default placeholder, confirm this step ran after the build and that home/index.html exists.
